## The SDR Engine

Sales development representatives (SDRs) generate the pipeline that feeds revenue growth. This guide quotes no benchmarks, pipeline multiples or pay ranges, because we have not cited a source for any. Set targets from your own data.

### SDR Hiring Profile

The ideal SDR candidate is usually:

- Early in their career
- Coachable and eager to learn
- Resilient and able to handle rejection
- Competitive, motivated by goals and recognition
- An articulate communicator, in writing and in speech
- Organized and process-oriented

### Where Strong SDRs Come From

We do not rank these by success rate, because we have no data to do so. Each background offers different strengths.

| Background | Strengths |
|---|---|
| Recent graduates, any major | Energy, coachability, ambition |
| Retail and hospitality | Customer interaction, resilience |
| Athletes | Competitiveness, discipline, teamwork |
| Teachers | Communication, patience, structure |
| Military | Discipline, process orientation, resilience |
| Career changers | Motivation, diverse perspective |

### SDR Compensation Design

Most SDR plans combine a base salary with performance pay. Design the components around the behaviors you want:

| Component | Purpose |
|---|---|
| Base salary | A stable income that attracts candidates |
| Monthly bonus | Rewards meeting or opportunity targets |
| Accelerator | Rewards over-performance |
| Promotion incentive | Encourages progression to AE |
| SPIFs | Drive specific behaviors for a short period |

Set amounts from a current, named compensation source for your market.

### A 90-Day SDR Onboarding Outline

| Period | Focus | Activities |
|---|---|---|
| Week 1 | Company and product | Product training, ICP review, tool setup |
| Week 2 | Process and messaging | Playbook review, call and email scripts, practice |
| Week 3 | Shadowing and practice | Listen to calls, role-play, first outreach |
| Week 4 | Partial targets | Own outreach, daily coaching, pipeline building |
| Weeks 5-8 | Rising targets | Increasing volume, refining technique |
| Weeks 9-12 | Full expectations | Full quota, advanced training |

### SDR Metrics

Track these, and set targets from your own history:

- Daily activities (calls and emails)
- Connect rate
- Meetings set
- Meeting-to-opportunity rate
- Pipeline generated

### SDR-to-AE Promotion Path

The SDR role should have a clear promotion path:

- **Timeline:** state how long people typically stay in the role
- **Criteria:** consistent attainment over several months
- **Preparation:** AE shadowing, closing training, account management skills
- **Transition:** a ramp period with a mentor AE

### Common SDR Team Mistakes

- **Hiring only for experience:** attitude and coachability matter
- **Inadequate training:** throwing SDRs into calls without preparation
- **Unrealistic ramp:** expecting full performance in the first month
- **No promotion path:** SDRs leave if they cannot see advancement
- **Measuring activity over outcomes:** high volume of poor calls does not build pipeline
